The chapter ends with the provisional arrangements made after the human seat fell vacant: other delegates may administer certain duties, but none may vote or speak as the human representative. Your arrival has made several “temporary” practices suddenly subject to review.

At the card table, Dena wins once more, then gathers her cards with a pleased little exhale.

“That’s enough charity for one evening.”

“It wasn’t charity,” Rashid says.

“It never is when you lose.”

Mara and Oren help her to her feet without fuss. Rashid walks them as far as the front hall, promising Dena he will look over the revised practice schedule tomorrow. She gives him a look that suggests she will hold him to it.

Thessaly remains by the fire, sorting the cards into unnervingly exact piles. The library waits quietly beyond the open doors, and somewhere upstairs the house settles around its new human heir.
